title: JRC Summer School on Non-Animal Approaches in Science
field: Non-animal approaches in science (alternatives to animal testing)
about: The JRC Summer School on Non-Animal Approaches in Science runs 24-28 May 2027 in Ispra, Italy, for up to 120 participants. Applications, with a motivation section and a flash presentation abstract of up to 250 words, opened 5 November 2026 and close 22 January 2027.
card_alt: Card for the JRC Summer School on Non-Animal Approaches in Science by the European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC), Ispra, Italy; deadline 22 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Colosseum in Rome, not Ispra.
